en.thes: LibreOffice's English thesaurus (th_en_US_v2, the mythes-en-us package, made from Princeton's WordNet 3.0:
WordNet licence, BSD-like; see https://wordnet.princeton.edu/license-and-commercial-use), put in one compact file by
tools/make_thesaurus.py. Lines: each meaning "pos|word|word|…" (n noun, v verb, a adjective, r adverb; a word's note
after "~": g broader, s similar, r related, a opposite), then "#", then "word<TAB>meaning numbers".
